briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ +0.7%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we held rather than forcing a buy on a low-conviction day, letting existing positions and their automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules do the work.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash reserves kept on hand, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today, with cash below the $500 threshold and no high-conviction setup (only a mildly positive, neutral market), the disciplined move was to hold that cash rather than force a purchase.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資人保留在手邊、隨時準備在出現好機會時動用的現金。今天由於可用現金低於500美元門檔，且市場僅呈溫和中性、缺乏高勝算的進場訊號，因此紀律性的做法是繼續持有現金，而不是勉強買進。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.7% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of major catalysts or news events to drive a stronger directional move. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer signals before committing fresh capital. This kind of quiet, low-volatility session is typical between earnings cycles and major economic data releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和向上，那斯達克指數上漲0.7%，標普500指數上漲0.3%，市場缺乏重大消息面刺激，整體呈現區間震盪格局。投資人在等待更明確的方向訊號前，普遍採取觀望態度，未大幅加碼。這種低波動的平靜交易日，通常出現在財報季與重大經濟數據公布之間的空檔。
